items.title: 不怕業界反對！韓國交易所強推9/14盤後ETF上路 對決虛擬資產交易所與ATS
items.title_en: Unafraid of Industry Opposition! Korean Exchange Pushes Post‑Market ETF Launch on Sep 14, Pitting It Against Crypto Exchanges and ATS
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，儘管業界對近期槓桿類產品波動存在擔憂，韓國交易所 (KRX) 仍將於 9 月 14 日正式開啟 ETF 盤後交易，意在與另類交易系統 (ATS) 業者 Nextrade 及全天候加密貨幣交易所競爭。
對此資管機構示警，無法精準計算即時盤後淨值 (NAV) 估算，恐擴大 ETF 價格背離幅度，但據悉 KRX 已拍板推進並正式要求投信提交可盤後交易 ETF 名單。此前，業界已呼籲 KRX 延後該業務上線，個股槓桿型 ETF 將不納入盤後交易的交易標的範圍。
《朝鮮日報》報導，KRX 堅持上路，部分源於 ATS 業者 Nextrade(NXT)壓力，NXT 每日交易 12 小時 (盤前 8:00-8:50、盤後 15:40-20:00)，KRX 在交易時數上居劣。NXT 目前還不能交易 ETF，要等金管當局全套核准(11、12 月有望獲批) 實際開跑，未來 3-4 個月 KRX 享壟斷窗口，某投信高層稱「KRX 想在這段領先期將先發優勢最大化」。
代幣化證券 (STO) 逼近也加劇與 24 小時虛擬資產平台的競爭，其核心訴求正是「24 小時交易＋即時交割」。含 STO 條文的《電子證券法》修正案在今年 1 月國會闖關通過，明年 2 月 4 日生效。一旦分散式帳本證券入市，虛擬資產交易所與代幣證券平台將正面交鋒。
美國方面，美國證交會 (SEC) 已准那斯達克交易所上鏈代幣化交易、紐約證交所獲准開發鏈上交割平台，那斯達克的 23 小時交易計畫 (日盤 4:00-20:00、夜盤 21:00 - 翌日 4:00) 在 4 月過關，兩家目標年底上線。
資管界憂心收盤後估計淨值 (iNAV) 算不準，擴大市價與淨值裂口。iNAV 靠標的即時價格估算，正規盤由 KOSCOM 即時供數。今年 4 月，KRX 決定盤前盤後不披露 iNAV，改由流動性提供商 (LP) 算公允價報價，義務同正規盤。
但業界反駁：LP 收盤後算 4 小時公允價需增加人手與系統，多數券商會避開成本；創贖回基礎建設也未齊備。沒 iNAV，純靠交易撮合的價格易大幅偏離。
上周三 (7 月 29 日)，南韓八大投信執行長與八大證券主管在金投協會長黃成燁主持下會談，傳達審慎共識。
與此同時，近期 ETF 市場萎縮增添隱憂，上月底南韓國內 ETF 總淨值 434.615 兆韓元，較 6 月底 512.408 兆蒸發 15.2%，或 77.793 兆韓元，單月跌破 500 兆關卡，上周四 (7 月 30 日) 隨股災再摔至 398.0339 兆、失守 400 兆。
1138 檔 ETF 中，891 檔上月收跌，531 檔跌逾 10%。上周五 (7 月 31 日) 提早上路的單股槓桿產品管制更澆冷水，管制後 4 日均量 1.6991 兆韓元，較前 5 日 10.7305 兆暴降 84%。
KRX 近日也通知主要投信業者，8 月新 ETF 掛牌恐因法規審查積壓、工作量暴增而延遲。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that despite industry concerns over recent volatility in leveraged products, the Korea Exchange (KRX) will officially launch post‑market ETF trading on September 14, aiming to compete with alternative trading system (ATS) operator Nextrade and all‑day cryptocurrency exchanges.

Asset managers warn that real‑time post‑market net asset value (NAV) cannot be calculated accurately, which could widen ETF price deviations, but KRX has already decided to move forward and formally asked fund companies to submit lists of ETFs eligible for post‑market trading. The industry had previously called for KRX to delay the rollout, and single‑stock leveraged ETFs will not be included in the post‑market trading universe.

The Chosun Ilbo reports that KRX is pressing ahead partly due to pressure from ATS operator Nextrade (ticker NXT). Nextrade trades 12 hours a day (pre‑market 08:00‑08:50, post‑market 15:40‑20:00), putting KRX at a disadvantage in trading hours. Nextrade cannot yet trade ETFs; it must wait for full regulatory approval, expected in November or December, before launching. For the next three to four months KRX will enjoy a monopoly window, and a senior fund executive said, “KRX wants to maximise its first‑mover advantage during this lead‑time.”

The approaching tokenised securities (STO) market intensifies competition with 24‑hour virtual‑asset platforms, whose core appeal is “24‑hour trading + instant settlement.” An amendment to the Electronic Securities Act that includes STO provisions cleared parliament in January and will take effect on February 4 next year. Once distributed‑ledger securities enter the market, crypto exchanges and token‑security platforms will face direct head‑to‑head competition.

In the United States, the SEC has approved Nasdaq’s on‑chain tokenised trading and the NYSE’s development of an on‑chain settlement platform. Nasdaq’s 23‑hour trading plan (day session 04:00‑20:00, night session 21:00‑04:00 the next day) cleared in April, with both firms targeting a year‑end launch.

Asset managers worry that post‑close estimated NAV (iNAV) will be inaccurate, widening the gap between market price and NAV. iNAV is derived from real‑time prices of the underlying assets, with regular session data supplied instantly by KOSCOM. In April this year KRX decided not to publish iNAV for pre‑ and post‑market sessions, instead delegating fair‑value pricing to liquidity providers (LPs), who bear the same obligations as in the regular session.

The industry pushes back, saying LPs would need extra staff and systems to calculate a four‑hour post‑close fair price, which most broker‑dealers would avoid due to cost; the creation/redemption infrastructure is also not ready. Without iNAV, prices derived solely from trade matching can deviate significantly from true value.

Last Wednesday (July 29), CEOs of South Korea’s eight largest fund companies and heads of the eight biggest securities firms met under the chairmanship of Kim T’ong‑ye, head of the Korea Financial Investment Association, to convey a consensus of caution.

At the same time, a recent contraction in the ETF market adds to concerns. At the end of last month, total domestic ETF net assets in South Korea stood at KRW 434.615 trillion, a 15.2% drop from KRW 512.408 trillion at the end of June—a loss of KRW 77.793 trillion—falling below the KRW 500 trillion threshold. By Thursday, July 30, amid a stock market crash, assets fell further to KRW 398.0339 trillion, breaking the KRW 400 trillion mark.

Of the 1,138 ETFs, 891 fell in price last month and 531 dropped more than 10%. On Friday, July 31, tighter regulation of single‑stock leveraged products—released early—further cooled the market; average daily turnover fell to KRW 1.6991 trillion over the four days after the rule change, down 84% from the previous five‑day average of KRW 10.7305 trillion.
KRX recently notified major fund managers that new ETFs slated for listing in August may be delayed due to a backlog of regulatory reviews and a surge in workload.

items.title: 國票金前7月大賺近30億元EPS 0.82元 金雞母證券獲利年增近4倍
items.title_en: KGI Bank's Net Profit Reaches NT$29.722 Billion in the First 7 Months, with EPS of NT$0.82
paras: 國票金控 (2889-TW) 今 (7) 日公布 2026 年 7 月自結稅後純益 1 億 8923 萬元，累計前 7 月稅後純益 29 億 7222 萬元，年增 204.82%；每股稅後純益 0.82 元，7 月底每股淨值 12.84 元。核心子公司國票證券前 7 月獲利年增近 4 倍，成為金控旗下最強金雞母，而國際票券累計獲利年增逾 6 成亦表現亮眼。

國票金控指出，票券子公司 7 月稅後純益為 1 億 8624 萬元，累計 1 至 7 月稅後純益達 17 億 4542 萬元，較去年同期成長 65.47%，票券、債券及股權三大核心業務均呈穩健成長態勢。其中，債券業務獲利較去年同期大幅成長，主要受惠於外幣債券養券收益由負轉正，加上債券買賣斷操作挹注收益；股權業務則因 AI 及電子產業類股走勢強勁，並適逢 7 月認列部分股票投資之股利收益入帳，獲利亦顯著提升。
證券子公司 7 月稅後純益為 2 億 4602 萬元，累計 1 至 7 月稅後純益達 22 億 8943 萬元，較去年同期成長 390.94%，整體獲利續創歷史新高。受惠台股今年前 7 月日均成交量達 1.2 兆元，帶動經紀業務手續費收入及融資、不限用途借貸利息收入顯著成長；此外，期貨衍生性商品、股票及權證等泛自營部位操作得宜，整體投資收益亦大幅增長，成為獲利成長重要動能。
創投子公司因投資有價證券評價、出售損益與股利收入獲利皆優，截至 115 年 7 月底，本業累計獲利達 1 億 6840 萬元，較去年同期成長近 925%。然而，權益法轉投資大陸之國旺租賃因當地經濟低迷，持續提存授信損失準備，使創投子公司整體收益由盈轉虧，今年 1 至 7 月稅後虧損 3161 萬元。
paras_en: KGI Bank (2889-TW) announced on the 7th that its after-tax net profit for July 2026 was NT$1.8923 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$29.7222 billion for the first 7 months, representing a year-on-year increase of 204.82%. The earnings per share (EPS) were NT$0.82, and the net worth per share at the end of July was NT$12.84. The core subsidiary, KGI Securities, saw its profit increase by nearly four times in the first 7 months, becoming the strongest 'golden laying hen' under the group, while the cumulative profit of International Bills also increased by more than 60%.

KGI Bank stated that the after-tax net profit of its bill and securities subsidiaries in July was NT$1.8624 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$17.4542 billion from January to July, representing a growth of 65.47% compared to the same period last year. The three core businesses of bills, bonds, and stocks all showed stable growth. Among them, the bond business saw significant growth due to the reversal of foreign bond holdings from negative to positive, as well as the injection of profits from bond trading operations.

The after-tax net profit of the securities subsidiary in July was NT$2.4602 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$22.8943 billion from January to July, representing a growth of 390.94% compared to the same period last year, and setting a new historical high for overall profit. Benefiting from the average daily trading volume of the Taiwan stock market reaching NT$1.2 trillion in the first 7 months, the brokerage business saw significant growth in handling fees and interest income from financing and unsecured loans.

The venture capital subsidiary saw significant growth in profit due to the valuation of investment securities, gains and losses from sales, and dividend income. As of the end of July 2026, the cumulative profit from its main business reached NT$1.684 billion, representing a growth of nearly 925% compared to the same period last year. However, due to the economic downturn in mainland China, the venture capital subsidiary's overall profit turned from profit to loss, with a net loss of NT$3161 million from January to July.

items.title: 菲律賓第二季經濟增速創5年新低 營建業低迷與高通膨成主因
items.title_en: Philippines' Q2 Economic Growth Hits 5-Year Low Due to Sluggish Construction and High Inflation
paras: 菲律賓統計局周五 (7 日) 公布，菲律賓 2026 年第二季 GDP 年增率僅為 2.3%。這一數據不僅低於媒體調查預期的 2.8%，更創下自 2021 年以來最弱的年率增幅。
經濟放緩的主要原因，在於營建業的大幅下滑及國內需求的轉弱。受去年爆發的防洪工程貪污醜聞影響，公共支出受限，投資者信心受挫，導致第二季營建業萎縮 14.8%，且整體投資額已連四季下滑，跌幅達 9.2%。
同時，占經濟活動三分之二以上的家庭支出增長也放緩至 2.8%，主因是今年前七個月平均通膨率高達 5.0%，嚴重侵蝕了民眾的購買力。
在農業領域，第二季產出成長率為 2.9%，相較去年同期的 6.0% 明顯放緩，但優於第一季的萎縮狀態。雖然家禽業 (成長 6.3%) 和畜牧業 (成長 3.6%) 表現尚可，但甘蔗產出驟降 22.5%，且面臨灌溉系統功能不彰的挑戰。此外，即將到來的「超級聖嬰現象」預計將在下半年對農作物生產和飼料價格造成負面衝擊。
儘管上半年平均經濟成長率僅 2.6%，低於政府設定的 3.5% 至 4.5% 年度目標，但經濟規劃部長 Arsenio Balisacan 仍表示持「審慎樂觀」態度。政府預期，隨着新批准的基礎設施項目啟動，本季支出將會回升。
菲律賓中央銀行將於 8 月 27 日舉行政策會議，屆時需在「支持經濟增長」與「對抗通膨」之間力求平衡。
paras_en: The Philippine Statistics Authority announced on Friday that the country's GDP growth rate for the second quarter of 2026 was only 2.3%, which is not only lower than the media's expected 2.8% but also the weakest annual growth rate since 2021.

The main reason for the economic slowdown is the significant decline in the construction industry and the weakening of domestic demand. The corruption scandal in the flood control project last year has limited public spending, damaging investor confidence and resulting in a 14.8% contraction in the construction industry in the second quarter, with overall investment declining for the fourth consecutive quarter by 9.2%.

At the same time, household spending, which accounts for more than two-thirds of economic activity, has also slowed down to 2.8%, mainly due to the high average inflation rate of 5.0% in the first seven months of the year, which has severely eroded people's purchasing power.

In the agricultural sector, the growth rate of output in the second quarter was 2.9%, which is a significant slowdown compared to the 6.0% in the same period last year, but better than the contraction in the first quarter. Although the poultry industry (growing 6.3%) and livestock industry (growing 3.6%) performed well, sugarcane production plummeted 22.5%, and the irrigation system is facing challenges. Furthermore, the upcoming 'super El Niño phenomenon' is expected to have a negative impact on crop production and feed prices in the second half of the year.

Despite the average economic growth rate of only 2.6% in the first half of the year, which is lower than the government's target of 3.5% to 4.5%, Economic Planning Secretary Arsenio Balisacan remains 'cautiously optimistic'. The government expects that with the newly approved infrastructure projects, spending will rebound this quarter.
The Philippine central bank will hold a policy meeting on August 27, at which time it will need to strike a balance between 'supporting economic growth' and 'fighting inflation'.

items.title: 國泰投信鄭立誠看台股：短線不用期待Ｖ轉 下半年「主被動ETF四六配」攻守兼具
items.title_en: Cathay Securities Investment Trust's Zheng Lìchéng Sees No Need for a V-Shaped Recovery in Taiwan Stocks in the Second Half of the Year
paras: 台股經歷 7 月暴跌逾 3000 點洗禮後，投資人關心下半年行情展望，國泰投信資深副總經理暨發言人鄭立誠今 (7) 日指出，短線受海外去槓桿與資金緊俏影響，導致籌碼凌亂，但台股基本面依舊穩健，晶圓代工大廠獲利更看好至 2030 年。他認為，下半年難以複製上半年瘋牛行情，也不用期待迅速「V 轉」，因此，投資人無須預測高點，宜採定期定額搭配「主被動 ETF 四六配」，在震盪期攻守兼具。
針對下半年與中長期的台股展望，鄭立誠指出，從近期法說會釋出的展望來看，許多產業與個股的獲利表現皆優於市場預期。以晶圓代工龍頭為例，其 AI 業務的成長能見度已延伸至 2030 年，由於其占加權指數權重近四成，在護國神山長期獲利成長趨勢明確的背景下，台股長線格局依然偏向多頭。
不過，他也提醒，下半年行情難以完全「複製貼上」上半年的強勢漲勢，由於近期籌碼需要時間清洗，加上資金緊俏導致融資管道受到適度限制，短線交易量能有所縮減。信心修復與籌碼歸隊都需要時間，投資人無須預測高點，也不必期待股市會迅速呈現「V 轉」，可能還需要一些時間，短線仍應留意個股波動風險。
面對劇烈波動的市場環境，鄭立誠建議，投資人若難以精準掌控選股與進出場時機，可善用 ETF 進行分散投資與漸進式布局。以規則明確的被動式 ETF 作為核心配置，占比約 60%，例如兼具「高股息」與「成長性」的標的，提供整體資產防守的底氣。
考量指數型產品無法面面俱到，可搭配主動式 ETF 做衛星布局，占比約 30% 至 40%，發揮較強的攻擊力與爆發力，精準捕捉輪動契機。
鄭立誠進一步指出，在長線趨勢看好的前提下，若遇大盤大幅修正，即是分批建立持股的好時機。投資人可透過「定期定額」方式參與市場成長，降低單壓單一股票或擇時錯誤的風險。
整體而言，鄭立誠強調，短期修正不改長線牛市格局，在基本面有撐、籌碼面仍在修復的階段，採取攻守兼具的 ETF 組合配置，並回歸長期基本面，將是當前相對有利的應對之道。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced a 7-month decline of over 3,000 points, leaving investors concerned about the outlook for the second half of the year. Cathay Securities Investment Trust's senior vice president and spokesperson, Zheng Lìchéng, said on July 7 that the short-term market is affected by overseas de-leveraging and tight capital, leading to chaotic market sentiment. However, the underlying fundamentals of the market remain stable, and the earnings of chip manufacturing giants are expected to be even better by 2030.

Regarding the outlook for Taiwan stocks in the second half of the year and the long term, Zheng Lìchéng pointed out that, based on the recent earnings reports, many industries and individual stocks have performed better than expected. For example, the AI business of the leading chip manufacturing company has a growth visibility that extends to 2030, and since it accounts for nearly 40% of the weighted index, the long-term trend of its earnings growth is clear. Therefore, the overall trend of the Taiwan stock market remains bullish in the long term.

However, he also reminded that the market trend in the second half of the year is unlikely to be a complete replica of the strong upward trend in the first half of the year. The recent market sentiment needs time to be cleared, and the tight capital has led to a moderate restriction on financing channels, resulting in a reduction in short-term trading volume. Confidence repair and capital return also require time, and investors do not need to predict the high point or expect the market to quickly present a V-shaped recovery. It may take some time, and short-term investors should still pay attention to the risk of individual stock fluctuations.

Facing the volatile market environment, Zheng Lìchéng suggested that investors who find it difficult to accurately control their stock selection and entry and exit timing can use ETFs for diversified investments and gradual layout. With a core configuration of about 60% using clear and passive ETFs, such as those with high dividend yields and growth potential, investors can provide a solid defense for their overall assets.

Considering that index products cannot cover everything, investors can use active ETFs as a satellite layout, with a proportion of about 30% to 40%, to unleash their strong attack and explosive power and accurately capture the opportunities for rotation.

Zheng Lìchéng further pointed out that, under the premise of a favorable long-term trend, if the market experiences a significant correction, it is a good time to establish a holding position in batches. Investors can participate in market growth through 'regular and regular' investments, reducing the risk of single-stock pressure or timing errors.

In summary, Zheng Lìchéng emphasized that short-term corrections do not change the long-term bull market trend, and in the stage of basic face support and capital repair, adopting a combination of ETFs with both attack and defense capabilities and returning to the long-term fundamental will be a relatively advantageous approach.

items.title: 汎瑋7月、前7月營收雙創同期新高 布局AI伺服器效益有成
items.title_en: Pan Wei's July Revenue, 7M Revenue Double Record High, AI Server Layout Benefits Achieved
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料 (6967-TW) 今 (7) 日公告 7 月營收為 1.51 億元、月減 7.06％、年增 18.39%，累計今 2026 年 1 至 7 月合併營收為 9.71 億元，年增 26.75％。汎瑋表示，7 月營收再創佳績，主要受惠於科技大廠及雲端服務業者 (CSP) 持續擴大 AI 基礎建設投資，帶動 AI 伺服器、高效能運算 (HPC) 及高速運算平台相關需求保持強勁。
汎瑋指出，汎瑋延續今年以來穩健成長動能，7 月與前 7 月營收雙雙創下歷年同期新高，主要憑藉電子功能性材料解決方案布局，已逐步發揮效益。另加上電動車及車用零配件、工業電腦、智慧家電等保持良好的出貨動能，也齊步推升高階電子功能性材料出貨穩健成長。
在利基型市場應用的需求上，汎瑋的出貨量也持續攀升，帶動營收比重進一步增長，將有助於汎瑋材料之毛利率表現持續精進，為整體營運帶來良好正面成績單。
汎瑋最初以經銷 3M 膠帶、接著劑及汽車隔熱紙起家，近年持續垂直整合發展，轉型為高階電子功能性材料的研發與製造商，也切入 AI 伺服器、高運算平台等相關需求，並切入機器人市場領域。
paras_en: Pan Wei Materials (6967-TW) announced today that its July revenue was NT$1.51 billion, down 7.06% month-on-month and up 18.39% year-on-year. Cumulatively, the company's combined revenue for January to July 2026 was NT$9.71 billion, up 26.75% year-on-year. Pan Wei stated that the company's July revenue again achieved a record high, mainly benefiting from the continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment by technology giants and cloud service providers (CSP), driving strong demand for AI servers, high-performance computing (HPC), and high-speed computing platforms.

Pan Wei pointed out that the company has continued its stable growth momentum since the beginning of the year, with both July and 7M revenue setting new highs for the same period in previous years. This is mainly due to the layout of electronic functional material solutions, which has gradually begun to bear fruit. In addition, the company's sales of electric vehicles and automotive components, industrial computers, and smart home appliances have maintained good sales momentum, also driving the growth of high-end electronic functional materials sales.

In terms of niche market applications, Pan Wei's sales volume has continued to rise, driving a further increase in revenue proportion, which will help Pan Wei Materials' gross margin to continue to improve, bringing a good positive performance to the company's overall operations.

Pan Wei initially started as a distributor of 3M adhesive tapes, adhesives, and automotive thermal insulation papers, and has continued to vertically integrate and transform into a developer and manufacturer of high-end electronic functional materials in recent years. The company has also entered the AI server, high-performance computing platform, and robotics markets.

items.title: 銅價飆出歷史新高！「銅博士」為何不再單純是經濟晴雨表？
paras: 國際銅價周四 (6 日) 飆上歷史新高，但這波漲勢背後的經濟成長訊號卻更加複雜，也讓素有經濟健康晴雨表之稱的「銅博士」(Dr. Copper)變得更難解讀。
剛果民主共和國為了推動國內加工產業發展，正式宣布禁止銅、鈷精礦出口後出現，使銅價飆上新高，美國銅期貨周四一度漲至每磅約 6.90 美元，但之後回落，終場走低。
銅廣泛應用於營建、電子、運輸甚至人工智慧 (AI) 領域，這使銅礦常被視為全球經濟活動是否升溫的指標。如今的高價可能反映的是供給受限、大規模電網投資、美國關稅政策的不確定性，以及電氣化需求增加等多重因素，而不單純代表全球經濟成長強勁。
Barchart 商品資料研究與分析主管 William Osnato 說：「支撐銅價維持高檔的核心因素，是資料中心與電網需求，這些需求是為了支應 AI 產業快速擴張。」他指出，銅需求的這波增長「更加集中，並非傳統上支撐銅價的廣泛經濟成長」。

供給吃緊成銅價上漲關鍵

銅價飆升也與供給有限有關。銅礦開採成本高昂，且從建設新礦到正式投產往往需要約 10 年，進一步限制供給增加的速度。
美國銀行金屬研究主管 Michael Widmer 表示，這波漲勢其實與其說是銅需求帶動，不如說是供給推動。目前礦山供給成長有限，加上供應中斷，都讓市場更加緊縮。全球最大單一銅生產國智利，近期因為大雪、強降雨及強風，都讓當地採礦作業大受影響。
此外，美國可能祭出《貿易擴張法》第 232 條關稅，以及中國收緊廢銅供應，都進一步壓縮 2026 年全球銅供給。美國總統川普去年 6 月簽署公告，對半成品銅產品及高銅含量衍生產品進口課徵 50% 關稅。

電氣化需求仍強勁

銅需求依然穩健，但主要與電氣化趨勢密切相關，卻不一定代表整體經濟正在蓬勃成長。
中國上半年的電網投資年增 13%，不久前還宣布雄心勃勃的電網升級計畫，預計投資約 5740 億美元。
Barchart 的 Osnato 表示，供應中斷正促使消費者從倫敦金屬交易所 (LME) 倉庫提取銅金屬，並推高精煉成本，「對銅博士而言，這確實是一種全新的局面。」

items.title: 美零售商折價出售關稅退稅權 以確保先拿到現金
items.title_en: US Retailers Discount Tax Refund Rights to Ensure Cash Flow
paras: 在美國最高法院裁定部分關稅違法後，許多企業原本可領回巨額退款，但因政府核發程序緩慢且充滿不確定性，業者面臨現金流壓力，正採取一種非典型的融資策略，寧願大幅折扣將未來的關稅退稅權出售給第三方買家，以換取即時的現金流注入。
根據《華爾街日報》與《Retail Dive》報導，包括 GoPro、American Eagle Outfitters 以及 The Children’s Place 在內的多家企業，已陸續與買家達成協議，轉讓價值數百萬美元的關稅退稅債權。
其中，American Eagle Outfitters 的做法最具代表性，該公司在其 2026 年第一季報告中透露，已將價值 6,890 萬美元的關稅退稅債權，以 1,860 萬美元的價格折價出售，換取現金流入。
另一家零售商 The Children’s Place 表示，公司支付了約 4,000 萬美元的關稅，並已同意將其中 3,820 萬美元的退稅債權轉讓給 Alnus Investors，換取 2,570 萬美元的資金。運動用品商 Academy Sports & Outdoors 同樣出售了部分債權以獲取約 1,050 萬美元，並保留部分向政府申請退稅的權利。
這股趨勢背後的主要原因，在於聯邦政府退稅進度緩慢。儘管美國最高法院於 2026 年 2 月裁定川普依據《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA) 徵收的關稅違法，但向美國海關及邊境保衛局 (CBP) 申請退稅的過程極其艱辛且漫長。 截至 7 月底，政府已退還約 1,000 億美元關稅，僅占總徵收額 1,660 億美元的 60%。
財務諮詢公司 BDO 的執行董事 David Wong 指出，這類交易對賣方而言最大的風險在於時間的不確定性。企業必須在「等待更長時間以獲得全額退稅」與「立即獲得較少資金」之間做出權衡。對於急需現金緩衝的零售商來說，即使損失部分潛在金額，現金融資帶來的靈活性仍具吸引力。
與此同時，貿易爭議仍未平息。雖然先前的關稅被裁定違法，但川普仍試圖透過 1974 年《貿易法》重啟關稅政策，目前已引發至少 25 個州政府與多個小企業團體提起訴訟。
paras_en: After the US Supreme Court ruled that some tariffs were illegal, many companies that could have received large refunds faced cash flow pressure due to the slow and uncertain government reimbursement process. To address this, they are adopting an unconventional financing strategy, opting to significantly discount their future tax refund rights to third-party buyers in exchange for immediate cash injections.

According to reports by The Wall Street Journal and Retail Dive, several companies, including GoPro, American Eagle Outfitters, and The Children's Place, have reached agreements with buyers to transfer tax refund rights valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

American Eagle Outfitters' approach is particularly representative, as the company disclosed in its first-quarter 2026 report that it had sold tax refund rights valued at $689 million for $186 million, securing cash inflow.

Another retailer, The Children's Place, stated that it paid approximately $400 million in tariffs and agreed to transfer $382 million in refund rights to Alnus Investors in exchange for $257 million in capital. Academy Sports & Outdoors, a sporting goods retailer, also sold part of its rights to obtain approximately $105 million and retained the right to apply for refunds from the government.

The underlying reason for this trend is the slow pace of federal refunds. Although the US Supreme Court ruled in February 2026 that tariffs imposed by Trump under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were illegal, the process of applying for refunds from US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is extremely difficult and lengthy. As of July 31, the government had returned approximately $100 billion in tariffs, accounting for only 60% of the total $166 billion collected.

David Wong, an executive director at financial consulting firm BDO, noted that the main risk for sellers in these transactions is the uncertainty of time. Companies must weigh the option of waiting longer to receive full refunds against receiving less capital immediately. For retailers that urgently need cash buffers, the flexibility provided by immediate financing is attractive, even if it means losing some potential value.

Meanwhile, trade disputes remain unresolved. Although the previous tariffs were ruled illegal, Trump is attempting to revive tariff policies under the 1974 Trade Act, which has led to at least 25 state governments and multiple small business groups filing lawsuits.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉權值股疲軟收跌170點痛失季線 8月首周漲1106點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Afternoon Session: Value Stocks Weaken, Down 170 Points, Miss Seasonal Line for the First Time
paras: 台股今（7）日早盤開高，最高漲逾 400 點，然而隨著伊朗限縮荷莫茲海峽航運，油價飆漲導致盤中台積電等權值股出現賣壓。加權指數由紅翻黑，最低來到 44109.88 點，跌近 300 點。終場跌幅收斂，收 44225.91 點，下跌 170.79 點或 0.38%，季線宣告再次失守，成交量 8192.04 點；8 月首周上漲 1106.16 點，周 K 線收紅，漲幅 2.57%。
權值股漲跌互現，台積電（2330-TW）上漲 5 元，漲約 0.2%，收 2370 元；聯發科（2454-TW）下跌 20 元，跌約 0.5%，收 3900 元；至於鴻海（2317-TW）、台達電（2308-TW）、廣達（2382-TW）及日月光投控（3711-TW）均跌近 2%；，電子權值股缺乏明顯撐盤力道。
油價揚升帶動塑化類股走強，南亞 (1303-TW) 漲約 3%，亞聚 (1308-TW) 漲約 2%，台聚 (1304-TW)、台塑 (1301-TW)、台化 (1326-TW) 均漲約 1%。
鋼價止跌回升，景氣可望回溫，延續前一日漲勢成盤面亮點，新光鋼（2031-TW）漲約 9%，東和鋼鐵（2006-TW）、中鴻（2014-TW）及第一銅（2009-TW）漲逾 2%，大成鋼（2027-TW）、海光（2038-TW）漲約 1%。
川湖 (2059-TW) 繳出亮眼業績，今日攻上漲停，帶動伺服器導軌族群南俊國際 (6584-TW) 同步漲停。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market opened high today (7) with a gain of over 400 points, but with Iran's restriction on the Hormuz Strait, oil prices surged, causing value stocks such as TSMC to experience selling pressure. The weighted index turned from red to black, hitting a low of 44109.88 points, down nearly 300 points. The final closing price was 44225.91 points, down 170.79 points or 0.38%, and the seasonal line was lost for the first time. Trading volume was 8192.04 points; the first week of August rose 1106.16 points, the weekly K line closed red, and the gain was 2.57%.

Value stocks fluctuated, with TSMC (2330-TW) rising by 5 NT dollars, up about 0.2%, closing at 2370 NT dollars; Mediatek (2454-TW) fell by 20 NT dollars, down about 0.5%, closing at 3900 NT dollars; Hon Hai (2317-TW), Delta Electronics (2308-TW), Gigabyte (2382-TW), and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (3711-TW) all fell by nearly 2%; electronic value stocks lacked a clear support force.

Rising oil prices drove the plastics sector to rise strongly, with South Asia (1303-TW) rising by about 3%, Asia Pacific (1308-TW) rising by about 2%, Taiwan Poly (1304-TW), Formosa Plastics (1301-TW), and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (1326-TW) all rising by about 1%.

Steel prices stopped falling and rebounded, and the economic outlook is expected to warm up, continuing the previous day's rising trend, making it a highlight on the market, with New Fung Group (2031-TW) rising by about 9%, Eastern Steel (2006-TW), China Steel (2014-TW), and First Copper (2009-TW) rising by over 2%, and Taichung Steel (2027-TW) and Haigang (2038-TW) rising by about 1%.

Changhua (2059-TW) reported outstanding performance, and today rose to the daily limit, driving the server and guide rail group, South Star International (6584-TW), to rise to the daily limit as well.

items.title: 國票金前7月大賺近30億元EPS 0.82元 金雞母證券獲利年增近4倍
items.title_en: KGI Bank's Net Profit Reaches NT$29.722 Billion in the First 7 Months, with EPS of NT$0.82
paras: 國票金控 (2889-TW) 今 (7) 日公布 2026 年 7 月自結稅後純益 1 億 8923 萬元，累計前 7 月稅後純益 29 億 7222 萬元，年增 204.82%；每股稅後純益 0.82 元，7 月底每股淨值 12.84 元。核心子公司國票證券前 7 月獲利年增近 4 倍，成為金控旗下最強金雞母，而國際票券累計獲利年增逾 6 成亦表現亮眼。

國票金控指出，票券子公司 7 月稅後純益為 1 億 8624 萬元，累計 1 至 7 月稅後純益達 17 億 4542 萬元，較去年同期成長 65.47%，票券、債券及股權三大核心業務均呈穩健成長態勢。其中，債券業務獲利較去年同期大幅成長，主要受惠於外幣債券養券收益由負轉正，加上債券買賣斷操作挹注收益；股權業務則因 AI 及電子產業類股走勢強勁，並適逢 7 月認列部分股票投資之股利收益入帳，獲利亦顯著提升。
證券子公司 7 月稅後純益為 2 億 4602 萬元，累計 1 至 7 月稅後純益達 22 億 8943 萬元，較去年同期成長 390.94%，整體獲利續創歷史新高。受惠台股今年前 7 月日均成交量達 1.2 兆元，帶動經紀業務手續費收入及融資、不限用途借貸利息收入顯著成長；此外，期貨衍生性商品、股票及權證等泛自營部位操作得宜，整體投資收益亦大幅增長，成為獲利成長重要動能。
創投子公司因投資有價證券評價、出售損益與股利收入獲利皆優，截至 115 年 7 月底，本業累計獲利達 1 億 6840 萬元，較去年同期成長近 925%。然而，權益法轉投資大陸之國旺租賃因當地經濟低迷，持續提存授信損失準備，使創投子公司整體收益由盈轉虧，今年 1 至 7 月稅後虧損 3161 萬元。
paras_en: KGI Bank (2889-TW) announced on the 7th that its after-tax net profit for July 2026 was NT$1.8923 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$29.7222 billion for the first 7 months, representing a year-on-year increase of 204.82%. The earnings per share (EPS) were NT$0.82, and the net worth per share at the end of July was NT$12.84. The core subsidiary, KGI Securities, saw its profit increase by nearly four times in the first 7 months, becoming the strongest 'golden laying hen' under the group, while the cumulative profit of International Bills also increased by more than 60%.

KGI Bank stated that the after-tax net profit of its bill and securities subsidiaries in July was NT$1.8624 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$17.4542 billion from January to July, representing a growth of 65.47% compared to the same period last year. The three core businesses of bills, bonds, and stocks all showed stable growth. Among them, the bond business saw significant growth due to the reversal of foreign bond holdings from negative to positive, as well as the injection of profits from bond trading operations.

The after-tax net profit of the securities subsidiary in July was NT$2.4602 billion, with a cumulative after-tax net profit of NT$22.8943 billion from January to July, representing a growth of 390.94% compared to the same period last year, and setting a new historical high for overall profit. Benefiting from the average daily trading volume of the Taiwan stock market reaching NT$1.2 trillion in the first 7 months, the brokerage business saw significant growth in handling fees and interest income from financing and unsecured loans.

The venture capital subsidiary saw significant growth in profit due to the valuation of investment securities, gains and losses from sales, and dividend income. As of the end of July 2026, the cumulative profit from its main business reached NT$1.684 billion, representing a growth of nearly 925% compared to the same period last year. However, due to the economic downturn in mainland China, the venture capital subsidiary's overall profit turned from profit to loss, with a net loss of NT$3161 million from January to July.

items.title: 國泰投信鄭立誠看台股：短線不用期待Ｖ轉 下半年「主被動ETF四六配」攻守兼具
items.title_en: Cathay Securities Investment Trust's Zheng Lìchéng Sees No Need for a V-Shaped Recovery in Taiwan Stocks in the Second Half of the Year
paras: 台股經歷 7 月暴跌逾 3000 點洗禮後，投資人關心下半年行情展望，國泰投信資深副總經理暨發言人鄭立誠今 (7) 日指出，短線受海外去槓桿與資金緊俏影響，導致籌碼凌亂，但台股基本面依舊穩健，晶圓代工大廠獲利更看好至 2030 年。他認為，下半年難以複製上半年瘋牛行情，也不用期待迅速「V 轉」，因此，投資人無須預測高點，宜採定期定額搭配「主被動 ETF 四六配」，在震盪期攻守兼具。
針對下半年與中長期的台股展望，鄭立誠指出，從近期法說會釋出的展望來看，許多產業與個股的獲利表現皆優於市場預期。以晶圓代工龍頭為例，其 AI 業務的成長能見度已延伸至 2030 年，由於其占加權指數權重近四成，在護國神山長期獲利成長趨勢明確的背景下，台股長線格局依然偏向多頭。
不過，他也提醒，下半年行情難以完全「複製貼上」上半年的強勢漲勢，由於近期籌碼需要時間清洗，加上資金緊俏導致融資管道受到適度限制，短線交易量能有所縮減。信心修復與籌碼歸隊都需要時間，投資人無須預測高點，也不必期待股市會迅速呈現「V 轉」，可能還需要一些時間，短線仍應留意個股波動風險。
面對劇烈波動的市場環境，鄭立誠建議，投資人若難以精準掌控選股與進出場時機，可善用 ETF 進行分散投資與漸進式布局。以規則明確的被動式 ETF 作為核心配置，占比約 60%，例如兼具「高股息」與「成長性」的標的，提供整體資產防守的底氣。
考量指數型產品無法面面俱到，可搭配主動式 ETF 做衛星布局，占比約 30% 至 40%，發揮較強的攻擊力與爆發力，精準捕捉輪動契機。
鄭立誠進一步指出，在長線趨勢看好的前提下，若遇大盤大幅修正，即是分批建立持股的好時機。投資人可透過「定期定額」方式參與市場成長，降低單壓單一股票或擇時錯誤的風險。
整體而言，鄭立誠強調，短期修正不改長線牛市格局，在基本面有撐、籌碼面仍在修復的階段，採取攻守兼具的 ETF 組合配置，並回歸長期基本面，將是當前相對有利的應對之道。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced a 7-month decline of over 3,000 points, leaving investors concerned about the outlook for the second half of the year. Cathay Securities Investment Trust's senior vice president and spokesperson, Zheng Lìchéng, said on July 7 that the short-term market is affected by overseas de-leveraging and tight capital, leading to chaotic market sentiment. However, the underlying fundamentals of the market remain stable, and the earnings of chip manufacturing giants are expected to be even better by 2030.

Regarding the outlook for Taiwan stocks in the second half of the year and the long term, Zheng Lìchéng pointed out that, based on the recent earnings reports, many industries and individual stocks have performed better than expected. For example, the AI business of the leading chip manufacturing company has a growth visibility that extends to 2030, and since it accounts for nearly 40% of the weighted index, the long-term trend of its earnings growth is clear. Therefore, the overall trend of the Taiwan stock market remains bullish in the long term.

However, he also reminded that the market trend in the second half of the year is unlikely to be a complete replica of the strong upward trend in the first half of the year. The recent market sentiment needs time to be cleared, and the tight capital has led to a moderate restriction on financing channels, resulting in a reduction in short-term trading volume. Confidence repair and capital return also require time, and investors do not need to predict the high point or expect the market to quickly present a V-shaped recovery. It may take some time, and short-term investors should still pay attention to the risk of individual stock fluctuations.

Facing the volatile market environment, Zheng Lìchéng suggested that investors who find it difficult to accurately control their stock selection and entry and exit timing can use ETFs for diversified investments and gradual layout. With a core configuration of about 60% using clear and passive ETFs, such as those with high dividend yields and growth potential, investors can provide a solid defense for their overall assets.

Considering that index products cannot cover everything, investors can use active ETFs as a satellite layout, with a proportion of about 30% to 40%, to unleash their strong attack and explosive power and accurately capture the opportunities for rotation.

Zheng Lìchéng further pointed out that, under the premise of a favorable long-term trend, if the market experiences a significant correction, it is a good time to establish a holding position in batches. Investors can participate in market growth through 'regular and regular' investments, reducing the risk of single-stock pressure or timing errors.

In summary, Zheng Lìchéng emphasized that short-term corrections do not change the long-term bull market trend, and in the stage of basic face support and capital repair, adopting a combination of ETFs with both attack and defense capabilities and returning to the long-term fundamental will be a relatively advantageous approach.

items.title: 汎瑋7月、前7月營收雙創同期新高 布局AI伺服器效益有成
items.title_en: Pan Wei's July Revenue, 7M Revenue Double Record High, AI Server Layout Benefits Achieved
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料 (6967-TW) 今 (7) 日公告 7 月營收為 1.51 億元、月減 7.06％、年增 18.39%，累計今 2026 年 1 至 7 月合併營收為 9.71 億元，年增 26.75％。汎瑋表示，7 月營收再創佳績，主要受惠於科技大廠及雲端服務業者 (CSP) 持續擴大 AI 基礎建設投資，帶動 AI 伺服器、高效能運算 (HPC) 及高速運算平台相關需求保持強勁。
汎瑋指出，汎瑋延續今年以來穩健成長動能，7 月與前 7 月營收雙雙創下歷年同期新高，主要憑藉電子功能性材料解決方案布局，已逐步發揮效益。另加上電動車及車用零配件、工業電腦、智慧家電等保持良好的出貨動能，也齊步推升高階電子功能性材料出貨穩健成長。
在利基型市場應用的需求上，汎瑋的出貨量也持續攀升，帶動營收比重進一步增長，將有助於汎瑋材料之毛利率表現持續精進，為整體營運帶來良好正面成績單。
汎瑋最初以經銷 3M 膠帶、接著劑及汽車隔熱紙起家，近年持續垂直整合發展，轉型為高階電子功能性材料的研發與製造商，也切入 AI 伺服器、高運算平台等相關需求，並切入機器人市場領域。
paras_en: Pan Wei Materials (6967-TW) announced today that its July revenue was NT$1.51 billion, down 7.06% month-on-month and up 18.39% year-on-year. Cumulatively, the company's combined revenue for January to July 2026 was NT$9.71 billion, up 26.75% year-on-year. Pan Wei stated that the company's July revenue again achieved a record high, mainly benefiting from the continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment by technology giants and cloud service providers (CSP), driving strong demand for AI servers, high-performance computing (HPC), and high-speed computing platforms.

Pan Wei pointed out that the company has continued its stable growth momentum since the beginning of the year, with both July and 7M revenue setting new highs for the same period in previous years. This is mainly due to the layout of electronic functional material solutions, which has gradually begun to bear fruit. In addition, the company's sales of electric vehicles and automotive components, industrial computers, and smart home appliances have maintained good sales momentum, also driving the growth of high-end electronic functional materials sales.

In terms of niche market applications, Pan Wei's sales volume has continued to rise, driving a further increase in revenue proportion, which will help Pan Wei Materials' gross margin to continue to improve, bringing a good positive performance to the company's overall operations.

Pan Wei initially started as a distributor of 3M adhesive tapes, adhesives, and automotive thermal insulation papers, and has continued to vertically integrate and transform into a developer and manufacturer of high-end electronic functional materials in recent years. The company has also entered the AI server, high-performance computing platform, and robotics markets.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉權值股疲軟收跌170點痛失季線 8月首周漲1106點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Afternoon Session: Value Stocks Weaken, Down 170 Points, Miss Seasonal Line for the First Time
paras: 台股今（7）日早盤開高，最高漲逾 400 點，然而隨著伊朗限縮荷莫茲海峽航運，油價飆漲導致盤中台積電等權值股出現賣壓。加權指數由紅翻黑，最低來到 44109.88 點，跌近 300 點。終場跌幅收斂，收 44225.91 點，下跌 170.79 點或 0.38%，季線宣告再次失守，成交量 8192.04 點；8 月首周上漲 1106.16 點，周 K 線收紅，漲幅 2.57%。
權值股漲跌互現，台積電（2330-TW）上漲 5 元，漲約 0.2%，收 2370 元；聯發科（2454-TW）下跌 20 元，跌約 0.5%，收 3900 元；至於鴻海（2317-TW）、台達電（2308-TW）、廣達（2382-TW）及日月光投控（3711-TW）均跌近 2%；，電子權值股缺乏明顯撐盤力道。
油價揚升帶動塑化類股走強，南亞 (1303-TW) 漲約 3%，亞聚 (1308-TW) 漲約 2%，台聚 (1304-TW)、台塑 (1301-TW)、台化 (1326-TW) 均漲約 1%。
鋼價止跌回升，景氣可望回溫，延續前一日漲勢成盤面亮點，新光鋼（2031-TW）漲約 9%，東和鋼鐵（2006-TW）、中鴻（2014-TW）及第一銅（2009-TW）漲逾 2%，大成鋼（2027-TW）、海光（2038-TW）漲約 1%。
川湖 (2059-TW) 繳出亮眼業績，今日攻上漲停，帶動伺服器導軌族群南俊國際 (6584-TW) 同步漲停。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market opened high today (7) with a gain of over 400 points, but with Iran's restriction on the Hormuz Strait, oil prices surged, causing value stocks such as TSMC to experience selling pressure. The weighted index turned from red to black, hitting a low of 44109.88 points, down nearly 300 points. The final closing price was 44225.91 points, down 170.79 points or 0.38%, and the seasonal line was lost for the first time. Trading volume was 8192.04 points; the first week of August rose 1106.16 points, the weekly K line closed red, and the gain was 2.57%.

Value stocks fluctuated, with TSMC (2330-TW) rising by 5 NT dollars, up about 0.2%, closing at 2370 NT dollars; Mediatek (2454-TW) fell by 20 NT dollars, down about 0.5%, closing at 3900 NT dollars; Hon Hai (2317-TW), Delta Electronics (2308-TW), Gigabyte (2382-TW), and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (3711-TW) all fell by nearly 2%; electronic value stocks lacked a clear support force.

Rising oil prices drove the plastics sector to rise strongly, with South Asia (1303-TW) rising by about 3%, Asia Pacific (1308-TW) rising by about 2%, Taiwan Poly (1304-TW), Formosa Plastics (1301-TW), and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (1326-TW) all rising by about 1%.

Steel prices stopped falling and rebounded, and the economic outlook is expected to warm up, continuing the previous day's rising trend, making it a highlight on the market, with New Fung Group (2031-TW) rising by about 9%, Eastern Steel (2006-TW), China Steel (2014-TW), and First Copper (2009-TW) rising by over 2%, and Taichung Steel (2027-TW) and Haigang (2038-TW) rising by about 1%.

Changhua (2059-TW) reported outstanding performance, and today rose to the daily limit, driving the server and guide rail group, South Star International (6584-TW), to rise to the daily limit as well.

items.title: 〈台達永續AI峰會〉鄭平：微電網將是未來幾年發展重點 看好三大應用需求
items.title_en: Delta Sustainable AI Summit: Chairman Zheng Ping Says Microgrids Will Be a Development Focus in Coming Years, Anticipates Strong Demand Across Three Key Applications
paras: 台達電 (2308-TW) 今 (7) 日舉辦「台達 55 周年永續 AI 峰會」，董事長鄭平致詞時表示，隨著全球電氣化程度持續提升，加上 AI 資料中心、電動車以及企業節能等需求，未來這一塊存在龐大的成長空間，台達電今年特別針對微電網要提出一個完整的方案，將是未來幾年發展重點。
鄭平表示，過去 COP 主要聚焦能源轉型，但今年 COP31 進一步將電氣化與減排放在同一個面向討論，並提出 2035 年電氣化程度達到 35% 的目標，但目前全球主要工業國目前電氣化程度約落在 20% 至 30% 之間，顯示未來仍這一塊仍存在龐大的成長空間。
以美國為例，目前電氣化程度約 22%，受到過去電力需求停滯及電網建設等因素影響，電氣化進程相對有限；歐洲則受到電價及稅制等因素影響，電氣化程度同樣偏低，但歐盟今年 7 月已宣示，目標在 2040 年將電氣化程度提升一倍至 46%。
中國近年的電氣化速度相對快速，過去 10 年電氣化程度已從 14% 提升至 28%，台灣則因電子產業持續擴大產能，電氣化程度約達 35%，約 65% 的能源使用屬於非電氣化，主要集中在工業、運輸及住宅等領域，交通運輸若電動車普及速度加快，將帶動大量能源需求由石化燃料轉向電力；工業部門同樣存在大量電氣化及節能改善空間。
鄭平表示，電氣化的前提是「要先有電」，而電力轉型除了增加再生能源發電量，也必須搭配儲能系統，以維持電力供需平衡，近年儲能裝置快速成長，整體裝置規模已增加約 30 倍，同時儲能成本也快速下降，隨著各國持續提高再生能源發電目標，儲能將成為支撐能源轉型的重要基礎建設。
鄭平表示，未來電力需求增加，主要著重在電動車、目前最熱門的 AI 資料中心，以及企業節能，尤其資料中心目前耗電量很高，因此很多國家甚至要求企業要興建資料中心時，必須自行解決所需電力。這牽涉到的範圍非常廣，包含資料中心內部節電效能的提升，以及供電系統的建置，也牽涉到資料中心微電網，有很多機會與需要突破的地方。
電動車這兩年雖然有一些停頓，不過以去年來說，仍有 30% 的新車銷售已經電動化，電動化趨勢其實不會回頭，一定會持續往前走；建築過去比較少被討論，但現在先進國家越來越重視建築用電，也有很多法規要求提升建築的能源使用效率，這一塊也非常重要，因為建築用電比例其實非常高。
隨著電氣化需求增加，鄭平認為，微電網必須從輸電、配電到用電，這些環節都要能夠配合得很好，最後才有辦法提升能效，達到減碳目標。台達電過往在在智慧工廠、資料中心，以及商業建築，都有很多解決方案，現在加速布建微電網，以及智慧人工智慧相關解決方案，透過新的技術，強化用電端與供電端的整體能源韌性。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308-TW) held its "Delta 55th Anniversary Sustainable AI Summit" today (the 7th), and Chairman Zheng Ping said that as global electrification continues to rise, driven by AI data centers, electric vehicles and corporate energy‑saving needs, there is huge growth potential. This year Delta is presenting a complete solution for microgrids, which will be a development focus in the next few years.

Zheng noted that past COP meetings mainly focused on energy transition, but COP31 this year linked electrification with emission reduction and set a target of 35% electrification by 2035. Currently, major industrialized nations are only at about 20%‑30% electrification, indicating ample room for growth.

Using the United States as an example, its electrification rate is about 22%; past stagnation in power demand and grid construction have limited progress. Europe also shows a low rate due to electricity prices and tax policies, but the EU announced in July that it aims to double its electrification level to 46% by 2040.

China’s electrification has accelerated, rising from 14% to 28% over the past decade. Taiwan, driven by expanding electronics production, is around 35% electrified, with roughly 65% of energy use still non‑electrified, mainly in industry, transport and residential sectors. Faster EV adoption will shift large energy demand from fossil fuels to electricity, and industry also holds significant electrification and efficiency‑improvement potential.

Zheng said the premise of electrification is “you need electricity first.” Power transition therefore requires not only more renewable generation but also storage systems to balance supply and demand. Storage installations have grown about 30‑fold in recent years, with costs falling rapidly, making storage a key infrastructure for the energy transition as countries raise renewable targets.

He added that future power demand will be driven by EVs, the booming AI data‑center market, and corporate energy‑saving efforts. Data centers consume huge amounts of electricity, and many countries now require companies building new centers to secure their own power supply. This involves improving internal energy‑efficiency, building supply systems, and developing microgrids for data centers, presenting many opportunities and challenges.

Although EV sales slowed somewhat in the past two years, about 30% of new‑car sales last year were electric, and the electrification trend will not reverse. Building electricity use, once rarely discussed, is now receiving increasing attention in advanced economies, with regulations pushing for higher energy‑use efficiency; this sector is also critical because building electricity accounts for a large share of total consumption.

With rising electrification demand, Zheng believes microgrids must integrate transmission, distribution and consumption seamlessly to improve efficiency and achieve carbon‑reduction goals. Delta has long offered solutions for smart factories, data centers and commercial buildings, and is now accelerating microgrid deployment and AI‑related solutions to strengthen overall energy resilience on both the demand and supply sides.

items.title: 歷年規模最大文博會！「台灣專利超級站」首次進駐 7天免費諮詢不斷電
items.title_en: Largest Ever Taiwan Cultural and Creative Expo! "Taiwan Patent Super Station" Debuts with 7 Days of Free Consultations
paras: 經濟部智慧財產局「台灣專利超級站（Taiwan Patent GO）」於 8 月 6 日至 12 日進駐 2026 台灣文化創意博覽會。智慧局表示，今年首度於文博會設置「台灣專利超級站」，不僅開創智財專業服務深入國家級文創盛會的全新指標，更展現政府積極結合文化創意與智慧財產保護的決心。展期中透過免費智慧財產諮詢服務及專題講座，協助具原創內容、文化特色或設計價值的品牌與創作者掌握智慧財產保護機制，進一步提升創新成果的保護能力與市場競爭力。
智慧局提到，今年的台灣文博會創下歷年規模最大、展期最長紀錄，並以「# 第零位元」為年度主題，在人工智慧快速發展的時代背景下，引領觀者重新思考人類創造力的本質與價值。智慧局在文博會設立「台灣專利超級站」，指標性地將專利、商標與著作權防護網延伸至文創產業最前線，向廣大創作者推廣智慧財產保護觀念，引導其於創作過程中及早建立權利布局思維，將創意成果有效轉化為具市場價值的智慧資產。
智慧局表示，為提供創作者即時且完整的協助，展覽期間特別設置「智慧財產諮詢處」，由專業人員於 7 天展期現場提供專利、商標及著作權等實務諮詢，協助創作者釐清不同智慧財產權的保護範圍與申請策略，建立正確的保護觀念，鞏固創作成果的永續發展與權益保障。
此外，針對文創工作者常面臨的品牌經營及著作權議題，智慧局於展期內特別規劃專題講座，分享商標申請、品牌保護及著作權運用等實務重點，協助創作者提升智財管理能力並降低侵權風險。
智慧局強調，文化創意與智慧財產保護相輔相成，期待透過「台灣專利超級站」與參展業者及民眾面對面交流，不僅能即時回應相關疑義，更能協助創作者在創意商品化及商業化過程中建立完整的權利防護網。
智慧局熱情邀請所有參展業者、文創工作者及廣大民眾，即日至 12 日展覽期間親臨南港展覽館「台灣專利超級站」，體驗專業諮詢與精彩講座。若無法親臨現場，創作者亦可善用智慧局官網提供的各項線上資源與申請服務，即時掌握最新智財資訊。未來，智慧局「台灣專利超級站」將深入各類文創與設計場域，提供多元且專業的智慧財產服務，促進台灣文化創意產業永續發展。
paras_en: The Intellectual Property Office of the Ministry of Economic Affairs' "Taiwan Patent GO" will be present at the 2026 Taiwan Cultural and Creative Expo from August 6 to 12. The agency says this is the first time a "Taiwan Patent Super Station" is set up at the expo, creating a new benchmark for professional IP services at a national-level cultural‑creative event and demonstrating the government's commitment to integrating cultural creativity with intellectual‑property protection. During the exhibition, free IP consultations and themed talks will help brands and creators with original content, cultural characteristics or design value understand protection mechanisms, thereby enhancing the safeguarding of innovative results and market competitiveness.

The agency notes that this year’s Taiwan Expo has set records for the largest scale and longest duration in its history, with the theme “#ZeroBit” reflecting the rapid development of artificial intelligence and prompting visitors to rethink the nature and value of human creativity. By establishing the Taiwan Patent Super Station at the expo, the IP office is extending the patent, trademark and copyright protection network to the forefront of the cultural‑creative industry, promoting IP awareness among creators and encouraging early rights‑planning so that creative outputs can be effectively turned into market‑valuable intellectual assets.

To provide creators with timely and comprehensive assistance, a "Intellectual Property Consultation Desk" will be staffed on‑site for the seven‑day exhibition. Professionals will offer practical advice on patents, trademarks and copyrights, helping creators clarify the scope of protection and filing strategies, build correct protection concepts, and secure the sustainable development and rights of their works.

In addition, the office has arranged special seminars during the expo to address common brand‑management and copyright issues faced by cultural‑creative workers. The talks will cover key practical points on trademark applications, brand protection and copyright utilization, helping creators improve IP management skills and reduce infringement risk.

The agency stresses that cultural creativity and IP protection complement each other, and hopes that face‑to‑face interaction at the Taiwan Patent Super Station with exhibitors and the public will not only answer questions instantly but also help creators establish a comprehensive rights‑protection network during the commercialization of their ideas.

The IP office warmly invites all exhibitors, cultural‑creative workers and the general public to visit the Taiwan Patent Super Station at the Nangang Exhibition Hall from now until the 12th to experience professional consultations and engaging talks. Those unable to attend in person can use the online resources and application services available on the agency’s website to stay updated on the latest IP information. In the future, the Taiwan Patent Super Station will deepen its presence across various cultural‑creative and design fields, offering diverse and professional IP services to promote the sustainable development of Taiwan’s cultural‑creative industry.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台橡上半年獲利創近5年新高 股價跳空鎖漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Taiwan Rubber Posts Record Profit in First Half, Shares Surge
paras: 橡膠股台橡 (2103-TW) 受惠中國新廠量產、原料成本壓力減輕及產品報價調漲、毛利提升，上半年稅後純益 18.67 億元、年增 613%，創近 5 年新高，EPS 達 2.26 元，受財報亮眼激勵，台橡今 (7) 日開盤直接跳空漲停來到 25 元，在外資連 3 買與主力偏多支援下，出現補漲與業績行情。
台橡今年上半年營業毛利率為 17.01％、年增 7 個百分點；營益率 11.09％、年增 8.33 個百分點，受惠於中國新廠量產，加上綠色輪胎等高值化產品出貨增加，今日出現短線追價力道。
法人指出，上半年因中東情勢緊張，在伊朗封鎖荷莫茲海峽後，一度推升油價大幅上漲，也帶動丁二烯價格持續攀升，使得合成橡膠生產成本快速墊高，報價機制由季報價調整為「月報價」，讓業者也調整報價反映成本上揚，加上物流成本增加，也推升台橡的獲利空間。
台橡產品包括 SBR、BR、SIS 等，應用於輪胎、鞋材、醫療及工業材料，其中輪胎用橡膠仍是最大營收來源，近年公司積極提高高值化產品比重，例如高性能輪胎及醫療材料力拼轉型空間。
paras_en: Taiwan Rubber (2103-TW) benefited from China's new factory production, reduced raw material costs, and increased product prices, resulting in a net profit of NT$18.67 billion in the first half, up 613% year-over-year, a new high in nearly five years. Earnings per share (EPS) reached NT$2.26. The company's impressive earnings report prompted Taiwan Rubber to jump 25% to NT$25 at the opening on July 7, with foreign investors buying for the third consecutive day and institutional investors supporting the stock, leading to a surge in price and a strong earnings trend.

Taiwan Rubber's operating margin in the first half was 17.01%, up 7 percentage points year-over-year, while its operating profit margin was 11.09%, up 8.33 percentage points year-over-year. The company benefited from China's new factory production and increased sales of high-value products such as green tires, leading to a short-term buying trend.

A company insider pointed out that the Middle East situation was tense in the first half, with Iran blocking the Hormuz Strait, causing oil prices to surge significantly, and propylene prices to continue rising, resulting in a rapid increase in the production costs of synthetic rubber. The company adjusted its pricing mechanism from quarterly to monthly, allowing it to reflect the increase in costs. Additionally, increased logistics costs also boosted Taiwan Rubber's profit space.

Taiwan Rubber's products include SBR, BR, SIS, and others, which are used in tires, footwear, medical, and industrial materials. Tire rubber remains the largest revenue source, and the company has been actively increasing the proportion of high-value products in recent years, such as high-performance tires and medical materials, to transform and expand its business space.

items.title: 盤中速報 - 櫃買市場加權指數下跌-7.86點至383.51點，跌幅2.01%
items.title_en: Taipei Stock Exchange Index Falls 7.86 Points to 383.51

items.title: 美零售商折價出售關稅退稅權 以確保先拿到現金
items.title_en: US Retailers Discount Tax Refund Rights to Ensure Cash Flow
paras: 在美國最高法院裁定部分關稅違法後，許多企業原本可領回巨額退款，但因政府核發程序緩慢且充滿不確定性，業者面臨現金流壓力，正採取一種非典型的融資策略，寧願大幅折扣將未來的關稅退稅權出售給第三方買家，以換取即時的現金流注入。
根據《華爾街日報》與《Retail Dive》報導，包括 GoPro、American Eagle Outfitters 以及 The Children’s Place 在內的多家企業，已陸續與買家達成協議，轉讓價值數百萬美元的關稅退稅債權。
其中，American Eagle Outfitters 的做法最具代表性，該公司在其 2026 年第一季報告中透露，已將價值 6,890 萬美元的關稅退稅債權，以 1,860 萬美元的價格折價出售，換取現金流入。
另一家零售商 The Children’s Place 表示，公司支付了約 4,000 萬美元的關稅，並已同意將其中 3,820 萬美元的退稅債權轉讓給 Alnus Investors，換取 2,570 萬美元的資金。運動用品商 Academy Sports & Outdoors 同樣出售了部分債權以獲取約 1,050 萬美元，並保留部分向政府申請退稅的權利。
這股趨勢背後的主要原因，在於聯邦政府退稅進度緩慢。儘管美國最高法院於 2026 年 2 月裁定川普依據《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA) 徵收的關稅違法，但向美國海關及邊境保衛局 (CBP) 申請退稅的過程極其艱辛且漫長。 截至 7 月底，政府已退還約 1,000 億美元關稅，僅占總徵收額 1,660 億美元的 60%。
財務諮詢公司 BDO 的執行董事 David Wong 指出，這類交易對賣方而言最大的風險在於時間的不確定性。企業必須在「等待更長時間以獲得全額退稅」與「立即獲得較少資金」之間做出權衡。對於急需現金緩衝的零售商來說，即使損失部分潛在金額，現金融資帶來的靈活性仍具吸引力。
與此同時，貿易爭議仍未平息。雖然先前的關稅被裁定違法，但川普仍試圖透過 1974 年《貿易法》重啟關稅政策，目前已引發至少 25 個州政府與多個小企業團體提起訴訟。
paras_en: After the US Supreme Court ruled that some tariffs were illegal, many companies that could have received large refunds faced cash flow pressure due to the slow and uncertain government reimbursement process. To address this, they are adopting an unconventional financing strategy, opting to significantly discount their future tax refund rights to third-party buyers in exchange for immediate cash injections.

According to reports by The Wall Street Journal and Retail Dive, several companies, including GoPro, American Eagle Outfitters, and The Children's Place, have reached agreements with buyers to transfer tax refund rights valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

American Eagle Outfitters' approach is particularly representative, as the company disclosed in its first-quarter 2026 report that it had sold tax refund rights valued at $689 million for $186 million, securing cash inflow.

Another retailer, The Children's Place, stated that it paid approximately $400 million in tariffs and agreed to transfer $382 million in refund rights to Alnus Investors in exchange for $257 million in capital. Academy Sports & Outdoors, a sporting goods retailer, also sold part of its rights to obtain approximately $105 million and retained the right to apply for refunds from the government.

The underlying reason for this trend is the slow pace of federal refunds. Although the US Supreme Court ruled in February 2026 that tariffs imposed by Trump under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were illegal, the process of applying for refunds from US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is extremely difficult and lengthy. As of July 31, the government had returned approximately $100 billion in tariffs, accounting for only 60% of the total $166 billion collected.

David Wong, an executive director at financial consulting firm BDO, noted that the main risk for sellers in these transactions is the uncertainty of time. Companies must weigh the option of waiting longer to receive full refunds against receiving less capital immediately. For retailers that urgently need cash buffers, the flexibility provided by immediate financing is attractive, even if it means losing some potential value.

Meanwhile, trade disputes remain unresolved. Although the previous tariffs were ruled illegal, Trump is attempting to revive tariff policies under the 1974 Trade Act, which has led to at least 25 state governments and multiple small business groups filing lawsuits.

items.title: 史上最缺一年將至？記憶體三巨頭把2027產能賣光 消息人士：一些AI公司已在「跪求晶片」
items.title_en: DRAM Shortage to Worsen in 2027 as Memory Giants Sell Out
paras: 隨著 AI 資本開支狂飆，全球 DRAM/HBM 產能遭提前掃貨。多家媒體彙整供應鏈消息指出，三星、SK 海力士、美光已經完成 2027 全年產能分配談判，DRAM 與 HBM 產線「提前售罄」，多數客戶最終配貨僅拿到一開始請求的 60%-70%，三家均無新增產線規劃，NAND 則因供應商較多，買方尚有零星談判空間，但整體仍緊俏。
夏季本是採購未來一年零組件旺季，今年卻上演「全年產能歸零」戲碼，凸顯 AI 伺服器、GPU 叢集與端側 Agent 對記憶體的吞噬速度。
SK 集團會長崔泰源近期直言，2027 年 AI 半導體需求較今年增加 60%-100%、整體記憶體需求增 50%-60%，「將是史上最嚴峻短缺與供需失衡」。
資深業內人士判斷，2026 年缺口已現，明年將從缺口擴大成結構性斷層。
溢價搶料已經開始。部分 AI 新創公司「跪求」最後批次，願付高於合約價換優先出貨，但晶圓物理極限卡死供給曲線。
與此同時，成本傳導鏈清晰；記憶體漲價→主機漲價→手機漲價。微軟本週調升 Xbox Series X/S 最高 150 美元，任天堂打算 9 月起調高 Switch 2 美國售價，離蘋果 iPhone 18 Pro 發表僅剩幾周，1399 美元起售價幾乎成市場共識，DRAM 斷料還可能拖累首銷現貨。
當「硬體老化降價」規律被記憶體超級週期推翻，消費電子正集體進入「越賣越貴」的新定價時代，而 2027 年才是壓力頂峰。
paras_en: Global DRAM and HBM production capacity has been depleted ahead of schedule, with Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron completing their 2027 annual production allocation negotiations. DRAM and HBM production lines have been sold out, with most customers receiving only 60-70% of their initial orders. The three companies have no plans to add new production lines, while NAND production has more suppliers, leaving some room for negotiation, but the overall market remains tight.

The summer season is typically a peak time for purchasing components for the next year, but this year has seen a 'zero production capacity' scenario, highlighting the rapid consumption of memory by AI servers, GPU clusters, and edge agents.

SK Group Chairman Choi Tae-won recently stated that AI semiconductor demand in 2027 will increase by 60-100% compared to this year, with overall memory demand increasing by 50-60%. He described it as 'the most severe shortage and supply imbalance in history'.
Industry insiders believe that the shortage has already begun in 2026 and will worsen in 2027, becoming a structural gap.

Price gouging has already started, with some AI startups 'kneeling' to request the last batch, willing to pay more than the contract price for priority delivery, but the physical limits of silicon are capping the supply curve.

Meanwhile, the cost transmission chain is clear: memory price increases → mainboard price increases → smartphone price increases. Microsoft has raised the price of Xbox Series X/S by up to $150 this week, while Nintendo plans to increase the price of Switch 2 in the US from September. The price of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro, which is set to be released in a few weeks, is expected to start at $1,399, almost a market consensus, and DRAM shortages may further delay the availability of new products.

As the 'hardware aging and price reduction' rule is being overturned by the memory supercycle, the consumer electronics industry is entering a new pricing era where 'the more you sell, the more expensive it gets', and 2027 is expected to be the peak of the pressure.

items.title: 供應吃緊！傳輝達擬下調Rubin Ultra HBM記憶體配置
paras: 《The Information》6 日報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 正評估一項頗為激進的調整方案——為下一代 AI GPU Rubin Ultra 推出 HBM 記憶體配置低於原先規劃的版本，以緩解高階 HBM 供應不足帶來的量產壓力。
知情人士透露，過去數週輝達已測試至少三個不同版本的 Rubin Ultra GPU，其中部分版本採用了低於最初規劃的 HBM 記憶體容量。輝達考慮推出低 HBM 記憶體配置版本，核心原因在於未來可能無法取得足夠數量的高階 HBM 晶片，以支撐原始設計的大規模量產。報導發布後，週四輝達股價收跌 0.1%，SK 海力士股價收跌 4.97%。

HBM 為何成為 AI 產業鏈「最硬瓶頸」

根據 TrendForce 集邦科技最新記憶體產業研究，DRAM 供不應求格局將延續至 2027 年。HBM 位元出貨量預計於 2027 年年增 50% 至 60%，但仍不足以滿足需求成長。
HBM 供應緊張源於兩大結構性瓶頸：
瓶頸一：整體 DRAM 產能受限。 2027 年整體 DRAM 供應仍維持緊缺，將限制原廠可分配給 HBM 的晶圓產能。SK 海力士公開表示 HBM、DRAM 及 NAND 產能於 2026 年已全部售罄；三星於 4 月財報中警告記憶體短缺將持續至 2027 年；美光執行長則表示，中期內僅能滿足關鍵客戶 50% 至三分之二的需求。
瓶頸二：HBM4e 12hi 驗證與良率仍存在不確定性。 HBM4e 12hi 的驗證時程與量產良率提升進度仍存在不確定性。HBM 製程複雜、良率要求高、擴產週期長，供應成長速度始終難以追上 AI 需求。
輝達自 2025 年至 2026 年上半年期間，持續以 HBM4e 12hi 作為 Rubin Ultra 的基準設計，直到 2026 年第三季才開始評估其他較低規格方案。
若最終決定調降 HBM 規格，預估將優先從調整堆疊層數著手。TrendForce 指出，輝達在 Rubin Ultra 世代的首要目標是提升 I/O 速度，而擴大 GPU 出貨量則屬於次要優先事項。

潛在影響：三層傳導機制

對輝達：出貨量 vs. 單晶片性能的權衡
HBM 記憶體容量縮減將影響晶片性能，但輝達可透過其他技術手段進行部分補償。具體而言：
I/O 速度降級： 若 HBM4e 如期完成驗證，Rubin Ultra 的 I/O 速度可由上一代 Rubin 的 8 至 11.7Gbps 提升至 14 至 16Gbps；若被迫改採 HBM4 低配方案，速度增幅可能僅維持在 11 至 12Gbps。
出貨量優先策略： 犧牲單顆 GPU 搭載的 HBM 記憶體容量，以換取更大的出貨規模，本質上是在「量」與「質」之間做取捨。
對輝達而言，此項調整的正面意義在於，可確保 Rubin Ultra 按計畫上市，而非繼續等待供應鏈擴產；負面影響則是產品競爭力可能較原規劃有所削弱。
對雲端業者：更多 GPU、更高成本
若 Rubin Ultra 最終採用較低 HBM 記憶體配置，在執行大型語言模型等 AI 工作負載時，客戶可能需要部署更多 GPU，才能完成原本由較少晶片即可完成的運算。
對微軟、Meta、亞馬遜、Google 等持續擴大 AI 資本支出的大型雲端業者而言，這意味著未來資料中心建設成本可能進一步攀升。HBM 價格上漲帶來的影響已不僅限於 AI 伺服器，而是推升整個科技產業的硬體成本。
對 HBM 供應商：定價權仍掌握在供應端
從供需角度來看，TrendForce 預估 2027 年 HBM 議價權仍偏向供應商，HBM 單位價格持續大幅上漲已成為市場共識。AI 晶片廠商將面臨 HBM 供給緊縮與採購成本提高的雙重壓力，因此採用較低容量 HBM 的動機將進一步增強。
DRAM 合約價預計於 2026 年第三季上漲 13% 至 18%，HBM 供應商在 2027 年前仍將持續掌握定價權。

市場與客戶看法分歧

報導指出，多家客戶對此調整的市場影響持相對平靜態度。兩家輝達客戶表示，即使 HBM 配置下調，預計也不會明顯削弱 Rubin Ultra GPU 的市場需求。
另有客戶表示，相較於單顆 GPU 搭載的 HBM 記憶體規格，其更看重與輝達維持長期合作關係。若產品售價同步調降，低 HBM 記憶體版本反而可能成為希望控制成本企業更具性價比的選擇。
輝達股價跌幅有限，反映市場對此消息抱持複雜解讀——一方面擔憂產品競爭力可能削弱，另一方面也肯定其「保出貨、保上市」策略。

投資分析

第一，主動調整優於被動斷供。
在產品規格與供應能力之間主動尋求平衡，雖然犧牲了部分性能上限，但可確保產品按時上市並順利量產。對輝達而言，「有貨可賣」比「規格完美卻缺貨」更具商業價值。
第二，客戶黏著度極高。
客戶更重視與輝達的長期合作關係，而非單顆 GPU 的 HBM 記憶體規格。只要 CUDA 生態系護城河仍在，客戶就不太可能因 HBM 容量減少而轉向競爭對手。
第三，價格彈性可部分抵銷性能損失。
若低 HBM 記憶體配置版本同步調降售價，反而可能擴大市場覆蓋率。對於推論等 HBM 需求較低的 AI 工作負載，低配版可能更具成本效益。
第四，這本質上是整個產業的供給限制，而非輝達的競爭劣勢。
所有 AI 晶片廠商都面臨相同的 HBM 供應短缺，部分 AI ASIC 業者也開始評估採用容量較低的 HBM 方案。輝達的應變速度與執行能力，仍是產業標竿。
三項值得留意的訊號
第一，「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」正成為 AI 擴張的重要限制。
即使是產業鏈中議價能力最強的輝達，產品規劃仍受到 HBM 供應限制。這也凸顯整個 AI 產業鏈的脆弱性——算力需求持續攀升，但 HBM 供給卻受限於擴產速度。
第二，產品差異化可能縮小。
若 Rubin Ultra 的 I/O 速度由 14 至 16Gbps 降至 11 至 12Gbps，與競爭對手的差距可能縮小。雖然短期內仍不足以撼動輝達的市場領導地位，但長期而言，產品競爭力下降的累積效應仍值得關注。
第三，HBM 供應商的成長預期可能受到影響。
若輝達大規模採用低 HBM 配置方案，HBM 位元需求可能低於市場原先預期，進而影響 SK 海力士、三星及美光等供應商的長期成長預期。
與大摩報告相互印證
這起事件，也與摩根士丹利 Shawn Kim 近期發布的《Memory – A Small Wrinkle》報告形成高度呼應。
「變化速率觸頂」正在發生。輝達評估調降 HBM 規格，本質上反映 HBM 價格漲幅與供應吃緊程度，已逐漸逼近產業鏈可承受的極限。
「但週期遠未結束」同樣成立。輝達仍全力推進 Rubin Ultra 量產，代表 AI 需求依舊強勁，只是供給端瓶頸迫使整個產業鏈做出妥協。
「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」正逐漸成為 AI 發展的核心瓶頸。大摩指出，「記憶體正日益成為 AI 建設的瓶頸，甚至可能成為唯一的瓶頸。」如今，輝達的實際行動，也進一步印證了這項判斷。

總結與展望

輝達評估下調 Rubin Ultra 的 HBM 記憶體配置，可說是 AI 產業「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」由理論走向現實的重要象徵。
事件背後的核心矛盾在於：AI 算力需求持續快速擴張，但 HBM 供給仍受限於實體產能擴充速度。輝達選擇犧牲部分單晶片性能，以換取更大的出貨規模，是一種務實的「次佳解」，既反映供應鏈的現實限制，也展現管理層在有限資源下追求商業利益最大化的策略。
從投資角度來看，此事件對輝達的影響偏向短期中性偏空、長期有限：

短期而言，產品規格調降可能引發市場對產品競爭力的疑慮。
中期而言，「保出貨」策略有助於維持營收成長的可預期性。
長期而言，只要 AI 需求趨勢不變，輝達的市場領導地位不太可能因一次 HBM 調整而受到根本影響。


至於 HBM 供應商（SK 海力士、三星、美光），此消息則偏向利空。若輝達未來大規模採用低 HBM 配置方案，HBM 位元需求可能低於原先預期。不過，TrendForce 仍預估 2027 年 HBM 議價權將持續偏向供應商，整體供需緊張格局並未改變。
後續值得觀察的重點包括：

輝達最終將採用哪一種 HBM 方案。
Rubin Ultra 是否能依照原定時程量產。
雲端服務供應商對新規格產品的實際採購反應。


這三項因素，將決定這道「小褶皺」是否只是 AI 產業發展中的短期波折，或將進一步演變為更深層的結構性變化。

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro漲價+缺貨雙重夾擊！A20 Pro良率高卻卡在DRAM 華爾街：新機1399美元起跳
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Faces Double Whammy: Price Hike and Shortage
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，距離 iPhone 18 系列發表倒數幾周，蘋果新機正面臨「成本暴衝＋DRAM 斷料」雙重夾擊，漲價幾成定局，首發缺貨亦難避免。
美國科技媒體《9to5mac》引述供應鏈與機構測算指出，漲價底氣來自三項硬體成本。一是全球 DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體持續緊缺、記憶體現貨價格暴漲；二是全新可變光圈主鏡頭成本較上一代增加 50%；三是首發台積電 2 奈米 A20 Pro 晶片搭配 WMCM 封裝，先進製程費用大幅墊高。
根據華爾街測算，為守住基本毛利，新機最低定價需 1299 美元，若計入影像溢價，蘋果很可能把 Pro 起售價鎖在 1399 美元，較此前同款漲價 300 美元；Pro Max 同步上調。
《彭博資訊》此前報導亦稱 Pro 漲幅介於 100 至 200 美元，僅摩根大通認為可透過零件優化對沖部分壓力。以 1299 美元試算，機型毛利率將從上代 47% 降至 44%，支撐 1399 美元站位。
產能端更棘手。A20 Pro 晶圓良率穩定、台積電產線正常，但專用 DRAM 供貨缺口巨大，已產出晶片無法完成 WMCM 整合封裝，台積電超 10 億美元等級的蘋果處理器產能被迫空轉。
供應鏈預判，iPhone 18 首發初期能保基礎鋪貨，但線上等待期拉長、線下門市現貨快速見底。
雪上加霜的是產品線收縮：今秋取消標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone Air 2(延至 2027 初)，僅留 iPhone Ultra 與 18 Pro 系列，入門款需求全數灌向 Pro，供需矛盾被進一步放大。
對消費者而言，新一代 Pro 不是「買不買得起」的單選，而是「付 1399 美元還要等多久」的雙重考驗。
對蘋果來說，DRAM 漲價潮正把硬體定價權從品牌溢價，部分交還給記憶體廠。
paras_en: A few weeks before the release of the iPhone 18 series, Apple's new machine is facing a double whammy of 'cost explosion + DRAM shortage', with a price hike almost certain and initial shortages unavoidable.

According to a report by US tech media 9to5mac, citing supply chain and institutional estimates, the price hike is driven by three hardware costs. Firstly, the global shortage of DRAM and NAND flash memory has led to a sharp increase in memory prices. Secondly, the new variable aperture main camera costs 50% more than the previous generation. Thirdly, the use of TSMC's 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip with WMCM packaging has significantly increased the cost of the advanced process.

According to Wall Street estimates, to maintain a basic profit margin, the new machine's minimum price would need to be $1,299. If image premium is factored in, Apple is likely to set the Pro starting price at $1,399, a $300 increase from the previous generation, with Pro Max following suit.

A previous report by Bloomberg Information also estimated that the Pro price hike would be between $100 and $200. However, Morgan Stanley believes that component optimization could help offset some of the pressure. At $1,299, the machine's profit margin would drop from 47% to 44%, supporting a $1,399 price point.

The production end is even more complicated. The A20 Pro chip has a stable yield rate, and TSMC's production lines are normal, but the shortage of specialized DRAM is massive. The produced chips cannot be completed with WMCM integration packaging, and TSMC's Apple processor production capacity has been forced to idle, with losses exceeding $1 billion.

Supply chain predictions indicate that the initial shipment of iPhone 18 will be able to meet basic demand, but online waiting periods will be extended, and offline store inventory will quickly dwindle.

Adding to the woes is the product line contraction: the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 (delayed to early 2027) will be canceled, leaving only the iPhone Ultra and 18 Pro series. The entry-level demand will be fully shifted to Pro, further exacerbating the supply-demand contradiction.
For consumers, the new Pro series is not a 'can't afford it' option, but a 'can I afford it and wait for how long' double test.
For Apple, the DRAM price surge is taking away the company's hardware pricing power, partly returning it to memory manufacturers.

items.title: AI資料中心需求升溫，Microchip財測優於預期，盤後股價漲7%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Demand Heats Up, Microchip Forecast Beats Expectations, After-Hours Stock Rises 7%
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Microchip Technology(MCHP-US)公布2027會計年度第一季財報，受惠於AI資料中心、工業、汽車及航太市場需求回升，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，並發布優於華爾街預估的第二季財測，激勵盤後股價上漲7%。
公司預估2027會計年度第二季營收將落在15.9億至16.2億美元，高於彙整分析師預估的15.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘預估為0.91至0.95美元，也優於市場預估的0.79美元。
Microchip表示，AI資料中心對晶片需求持續增溫，加上工業與汽車市場景氣循環回升，以及地緣政治因素帶動航太與國防支出成長，共同支撐業績表現。
2027會計年度第一季營收為14.9億美元，高於市場預估的14.6億美元；調整後每股盈餘為0.76美元，也優於市場預估的0.69美元。
同業安森美Onsemi(ON-US)本周稍早也發布優於預期的第三季財測，指出AI資料中心帶動電源管理晶片需求持續成長，顯示AI基礎建設投資仍是類比與電源半導體市場的重要成長動能。

paras_en: August 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Microchip Technology (MCHP-US) released its fiscal 2027 first‑quarter results. Benefiting from a rebound in AI data‑center, industrial, automotive and aerospace demand, both revenue and profit topped market expectations, and the company issued a second‑quarter outlook that beat Wall Street forecasts, lifting the after‑hours share price by 7%.

The company projects fiscal 2027 second‑quarter revenue of $1.59 billion to $1.62 billion, above analysts’ consensus of $1.55 billion, and adjusted earnings per share of $0.91 to $0.95, also ahead of the market estimate of $0.79.

Microchip said that rising chip demand from AI data centers, combined with a recovery in industrial and automotive cycles and geopolitical factors driving growth in aerospace and defense spending, together support the performance.
Fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue was $1.49 billion, higher than the market estimate of $1.46 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $0.76, also above the market forecast of $0.69.

Peer Onsemi (ON-US) also released an above‑expectations third‑quarter outlook earlier this week, noting that AI data centers continue to boost demand for power‑management chips, indicating that AI infrastructure investment remains a key growth driver for the analog and power semiconductor markets.
